text.p: Malaysia's largest banking group, Malayan Banking Bhd (Maybank), is looking into buying a controlling stake in the Philippines National-Republic Bank (PNB-RP), The Star said on Friday.
The newspaper reported from Davao City that Maybank is among 10 foreign and Filipino banks keen to acquire a stake in the bank due to be put up for auction on December 12.
The Star said that Philippines National Bank officials had confirmed that Maybank was interested in bidding for its 58.8 percent stake in PNB-RP.
Officials at Maybank were not immediately available for comment. -- Kuala Lumpur newsroom (603-230 8911)
